input: Get a mole checked at the dermatologist

gold.taskTitle: Get a suspicious mole checked by dermatologist
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to have a mole examined by a dermatologist to assess its appearance or health concern.

questions.title: Which specific mole or body location concerns you?
questions.description: Identify the exact location of the mole on the body that needs to be checked.

questions.title: What is prompting you to get it checked now?
questions.description: Understand the reason or trigger, such as a change in size, color, shape, or a routine check.

questions.title: Do you already have a dermatologist you see?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has an existing dermatologist or needs to find a new one.

questions.title: Does your insurance cover dermatology appointments?
questions.description: Clarify whether insurance will be used and if there are any coverage considerations or referral requirements.

questions.title: How urgently do you feel this needs to be seen?
questions.description: Gauge the user's sense of urgency to help prioritize scheduling, from routine to as-soon-as-possible.

questions.title: What city or area should the appointment be in?
questions.description: Identify the geographic location to help find a nearby dermatologist if needed.

questions.title: Have you taken any photos of the mole over time?
questions.description: Find out if the user has documented the mole's appearance, which could be useful to bring to the appointment.
